steps.name: EXCLUSIVE_ROOT_PRE_VERIFY
steps.safety: Ensures all ancestor directories exist, have valid Windows st_file_attributes, are not reparse points, and the leaf does NOT exist (os.lstat catches only FileNotFoundError).

steps.name: EXCLUSIVE_ROOT_POST_VERIFY
steps.action: verify_path_ancestry on output_dir with is_new_leaf=False, require_dir=True
steps.safety: Re-inspects newly created directory ensuring attributes integer and no reparse points.

steps.name: EXCLUSIVE_STAGING_WRITE
steps.action: open(staging_bundle_path, 'xb') and write compact UTF-8 bundle bytes
steps.safety: O_EXCL ensures staging file does not preexist.

steps.name: EXCLUSIVE_SIDECAR_WRITE
steps.action: open(out_sha_path, 'xb') and write 64 uppercase ASCII hex characters

steps.name: EXCLUSIVE_PROVENANCE_WRITE
steps.safety: Binds captured read-once stats and SHA-256 for spec, parent config, child config, bundle, and publisher.

steps.name: EXCLUSIVE_ROOT_FINAL_VERIFY
steps.action: verify_path_ancestry on output_dir before final link
steps.safety: Ensures root remains valid and non-reparse.

steps.name: ATOMIC_ENTRY_LINK
steps.safety: Atomic directory entry creation on NTFS. Zero destructive overwrites, fallbacks, or renames. Partial outputs preserved on error.
